units.text: Aspose.OCR FOSS for .NET reads images and PDF documents and converts them into machine-readable text. It supports input formats including single images and multi-page PDFs, and produces recognition results containing text and line-level bounding boxes. The product runs on .NET Standard and multiple .NET versions, as well as .NET Framework, and depends on Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime and System.Drawing.Common.
It performs local optical character recognition using embedded ONNX models, requiring no network access or external model files, and returns text and line coordinates through Aspose.OCR.OcrOutput.

It recognizes Latin-script text, including diacritical characters, and provides full-page text through RecognitionResult.RecognitionText and per-line results through RecognitionResult.RecognitionLinesResult.
It returns individual line bounding boxes as System.Drawing.Rectangle coordinates through RecognitionResult.RecognitionLinesResult, enabling pixel-precise layout analysis.
It accepts raster images and PDF documents through Aspose.OCR.OcrInput, supporting InputType.SingleImage for individual images and InputType.PDF for multi-page documents.
It targets netstandard2.0, net48, net8.0, net9.0, and net10.0, enabling use across modern and legacy .NET applications.
It processes multiple files of the same InputType in a single OcrInput container, preserving their order and returning one RecognitionResult per input file.

Aspose.OCR FOSS for .NET exposes a small set of public entry-point classes. The AsposeOcr class performs recognition, OcrInput collects source images or PDF pages, and RecognitionResult holds the extracted text and line-level data.
The AsposeOcr.Recognize method accepts an OcrInput container and returns an OcrOutput collection, where each element corresponds to one source image or PDF page.
The OcrInput class is constructed with an InputType to specify whether sources are single raster images or PDF pages, and provides Add and Dispose members to populate and clear the container.
Each RecognitionResult exposes RecognitionText for the full-page text and RecognitionLinesResult for ordered line text and bounding rectangles, with LinesResult providing TextInLine and Line members.
